No file was written (--check)"). Each of the 8 evidence ids exists. The worktree has no change from the check (`git status --short` is equal to the start). Nothing ran against production or the Cloudflare API, and no credential was read. Read-only gh commands: `gh pr view 250`, `gh pr view 251`, `gh issue view 61`. decisions.question: Who looks at the live service to get the five facts that the record does not have?
decisions.options: (1) no-reads, "Nobody reads the live service": no work and no use of the login for a read. It changes two settled answers and says so: D-LOAD-02 ("The region comes from one D1 result") and D-CODE-02 (request count "read first"). About 900 lines for old data forms stay, or go on an assumption. Nobody learns if an earlier database with stored tokens exists. (2) maintainer-reads, "You make each read": 3 commands and 2 dashboard pages, about 15 minutes (estimate). The implementation waits at three places. 0 rows written. (3) commands-by-implementation, "The implementation runs the commands": 3 wrangler commands of a fixed list (`wrangler d1 info visonaut --env production --json`; 5 SELECT count statements with `--command`; `wrangler d1 list --json`). The maintainer looks at one number, the request count of the Worker visonaut-compare, about 1 minute (estimate), as a check box in the issue that deletes the Worker. The CPU time of one trace is a second, optional look, possible only before the change of D-RUN-03 is live. 0 rows written, checked through meta.rows_written and meta.changed_db. (4) all-by-implementation, "The implementation makes each read, also in the dashboard": option 3, and the implementation opens the two dashboard pages in the Chrome session of the maintainer. Risk: that session is the complete Cloudflare account, with billing, DNS, and the projects that are not Visonaut.
decisions.recommended: commands-by-implementation. Evidence: it uses the tool and the login that the authorized UPDATE of D-AUTH-05 already uses; each result shows 0 rows written; read 1 is a step of the settled answer to D-LOAD-02; the repository has two examples of read-only wrangler use (docs/operations/simplification-inventory.json:3, docs/baseline-delta-cutover.md:104-110); it keeps the words 'read first' of D-CODE-02 with about 1 minute of the maintainer. It is wrong if no agent may use the Cloudflare login for more than the two writes (then 'You make each read'), or if the wrangler login of the computer is no longer valid (a login file from 2026-10-05 exists; nobody tested it).
